title: Window-Local Utilities
description: All utilities are local to the window instance. Only tools are mode-wide. Fix puzzle 3D transform activating gumball across all windows by carrying per-window activeUtilityByWindowId on ViewState and stamping each window's utility during refreshUi.
summary:
Follow-up: transform utility selection showed no gumball because refreshUi raced the React render.

Root cause: after WINDOW-LOCAL-UTILITIES, refreshUi sends only activeUtilityByWindowId (singular activeUtilityId cleared). setActiveUtility dispatched SET_ACTIVE_UTILITY but updated activeUtilityByWindowIdRef only on the next render — handleAction's follow-up refresh ran first with a stale empty map, so plugin render never stamped "transform" and gumballActive stayed false.

Fix: setActiveUtilityForWindow / clearAllWindowUtilities sync the ref immediately at every utility/tool activation site (onAction interceptors + applyHostEffects setActiveUtility/setActiveTool) before any refreshUi can run. Also sync activeToolIdRef on tool switches.

Tests: vitest regression for just-activated transform visible to refresh before render (3 related tests pass).
